nonfinite: numeric nonfinite failure in L1/L2 SC; no tag
decode_failed: other L1/L2 SC exception; no tag
exact: tag pass and label == true label
undetected: tag pass and not exact (never success)
ratio_rule: disclosure_ce_ratio = design leakage / true block total NLL bits is a sample cross-entropy-normalized disclosure ratio and is explicitly NOT qualification reconciliation efficiency
